ions, connection)
        return connection
    end

    local function shaderDisconnectAll()
        ShaderCustomActiveSlider = nil
        for index = #ShaderCustomConnections, 1, -1 do
            pcall(function() ShaderCustomConnections[index]:Disconnect() end)
            ShaderCustomConnections[index] = nil
        end
    end

    local function shaderSetModeLabel(name)
        local modeKey = name
        local labelES = tostring(name)
        local labelEN = tostring(name)
        for key, card in pairs(ShaderModeCards) do
            if key == name or card.labelES == name or card.labelEN == name then
                modeKey = key
                labelES = card.labelES
                labelEN = card.labelEN
                break
            end
        end
        if ShaderModeLabel then
            local activeES = "Modo activo: " .. labelES
            local activeEN = "Active mode: " .. labelEN
            ShaderModeLabel.Text = GetText(activeES, activeEN)
        end
        for key, card in pairs(ShaderModeCards) do
            if card.setSelected then
                pcall(function() card.setSelected(key == modeKey) end)
            end
        end
    end

    local function shaderCreateModeCard(parent, spec)
        local holder = mk("Frame", {
            Parent = parent,
            Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 156),
            BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Secondary,
            BackgroundTransparency = 0.2,
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
            ClipsDescendants = true,
            ZIndex = 9,
        })
        holder:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "Secondary")
        holder:SetAttribute("IsShaderModeCard", true)
        corner(holder, 14)
        local holderStroke = stroke(holder, Theme.Stroke, 1.2, 0.48)
        local holderScale = mk("UIScale", {Parent = holder, Scale = 1})

        local presetData = ShaderManager and ShaderManager.Presets and ShaderManager.Presets[spec.key]
        local lighting = type(presetData) == "table" and type(presetData.Lighting) == "table" and presetData.Lighting or {}
        local atmosphere = type(presetData) == "table" and type(presetData.Atmosphere) == "table" and presetData.Atmosphere or {}
        local function col(v, fallback) return typeof(v) == "Color3" and v or fallback end

        local skyTop, skyMid, skyLow
        if spec.key == "Custom" then
            skyTop, skyMid, skyLow = Theme.Background, Theme.Secondary, Theme.Accent
        elseif spec.key == "Original" then
            skyTop, skyMid, skyLow = Color3.fromRGB(40, 44, 52), Color3.fromRGB(96, 104, 118), Color3.fromRGB(170, 176, 186)
        else
            skyTop = col(atmosphere.Decay, Color3.fromRGB(40, 50, 90))
            skyMid = col(atmosphere.Color, Color3.fromRGB(120, 140, 200))
            skyLow = col(lighting.ColorShift_Top, Color3.fromRGB(255, 220, 180))
        end

        local banner = mk("Frame", {
            Parent = holder,
            Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 78),
            Position = UDim2.new(0, 5, 0, 5),
            BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
            ClipsDescendants = true,
            ZIndex = 10,
        })
        corner(banner, 11)
        mk("UIGradient", {
            Parent = banner,
            Rotation = 90,
            Color = ColorSequence.new({
                ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, skyTop),
                ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.6, skyMid),
                ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, skyLow),
            }),
        })

        local clock = tonumber(lighting.ClockTime)
        if clock then
            local isNight = clock < 5.5 or clock > 19
            local dayPos = math.clamp((clock - 6) / 12, 0, 1)
            local sunX = isNight and 0.78 or (0.12 + dayPos * 0.76)
            local sunY = isNight and 0.28 or (0.78 - math.sin(math.pi * dayPos) * 0.55)
            local sunSize = isNight and 14 or 20
            local sun = mk("Frame", {
                Parent = banner,
                Size = UDim2.fromOffset(sunSize, sunSize),
                AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
                Position = UDim2.new(sunX, 0, sunY, 0),
                BackgroundColor3 = isNight and Color3.fromRGB(235, 238, 255) or col(lighting.ColorShift_Top, Color3.fromRGB(255, 230, 170)),
                BorderSizePixel = 0,
                ZIndex = 11,
            })
            corner(sun, 999)
            mk("UIStroke", {Parent = sun, Color = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), Thickness = isNight and 2 or 4, Transparency = 0.7})
            if isNight then
                local seeds = {{0.15, 0.2}, {0.3, 0.45}, {0.46, 0.18}, {0.6, 0.38}, {0.9, 0.55}, {0.22, 0.6}}
                for _, p in ipairs(seeds) do
                    local star = mk("Frame", {
                        Parent = banner, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(2, 2), Position = UDim2.new(p[1], 0, p[2], 0),
                        BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 0.2, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 11,
                    })
                    corner(star, 999)
                end
            end
            local chip = mk("TextLabel", {
                Parent = banner,
                Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 18),
                AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X,
                Position = UDim2.new(0, 6, 0, 6),
                BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0),
                BackgroundTransparency = 0.45,
                Text = string.format("%02d:%02d", math.floor(clock) % 24, math.floor((clock % 1) * 60 + 0.5) % 60),
                TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
                Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
                TextSize = 10,
                ZIndex = 14,
            })
            chip:SetAttribute("IgnoreTextEffect", true)
            corner(chip, 999)
            mk("UIPadding", {Parent = chip, PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 7), PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 7)})
        end
        if spec.key == "Level0" then
            for i = 1, 12 do
                mk("Frame", {
                    Parent = banner, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 1), Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, (i - 1) / 12, 0),
                    BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0), BackgroundTransparency = 0.82, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 12,
                })
            end
        end
        if spec.key == "Rain" or spec.key == "Stormfront" or spec.key == "OilWet" or spec.key == "Monsoon" then
            for i = 1, 9 do
                mk("Frame", {
                    Parent = banner, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(1, 12), Rotation = 18,
                    Position = UDim2.new((i - 1) / 9 + 0.04, 0, (i % 3) * 0.22 + 0.05, 0),
                    BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 230, 255), BackgroundTransparency = 0.45, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 12,
                })
            end
        end
        local hills = mk("Frame", {
            Parent = banner,
            Size = UDim2.new(1.3, 0, 0, 34),
            AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0),
            Position = UDim2.new(0.45, 0, 1, -16),
            BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0),
            BackgroundTransparency = 0.35,
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
            ZIndex = 12,
        })
        corner(hills, 999)
        local hills2 = mk("Frame", {
            Parent = banner,
            Size = UDim2.new(0.9, 0, 0, 30),
            AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0),
            Position = UDim2.new(0.85, 0, 1, -11),
            BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0),
            BackgroundTransparency = 0.15,
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
            ZIndex = 13,
        })
        corner(hills2, 999)

        local glow = mk("Frame", {
            Parent = holder,
            Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 3),
            Position = UDim2.new(0, 5, 0, 84),
            BackgroundColor3 = Theme.AccentOff,
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
            ZIndex = 10,
        })
        glow:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "AccentOff")
        corner(glow, 99)

        local title = mk("TextLabel", {
            Parent = holder,
            Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 20),
            Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 92),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Text = GetText(spec.labelES, spec.labelEN),
            TextColor3 = Theme.Text,
            Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack,
            TextSize = 14,
            TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
            TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
            ZIndex = 10,
        })
        title:SetAttribute("ThemeTextRole", "Text")
        title:SetAttribute("TextSpanish", spec.labelES)
        title:SetAttribute("TextEnglish", spec.labelEN)

        local subtitle = mk("TextLabel", {
            Parent = holder,
            Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 30),
            Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 114),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Text = GetText(spec.descES, spec.descEN),
            TextColor3 = Theme.TextDim,
            Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium,
            TextSize = 10,
            TextWrapped = true,
            TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
            TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top,
            TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
            ZIndex = 10,
        })
        subtitle:SetAttribute("ThemeTextRole", "TextDim")
        subtitle:SetAttribute("TextSpanish", spec.descES)
        subtitle:SetAttribute("TextEnglish", spec.descEN)

        local badge = mk("TextLabel", {
            Parent = holder,
            Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 20),
            AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X,
            AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0),
            Position = UDim2.new(1, -11, 0, 11),
            BackgroundColor3 = Theme.AccentOff,
            BackgroundTransparency = 0.1,
            Text = GetText("APLICAR", "APPLY"),
            TextColor3 = Theme.Text,
            Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack,
            TextSize = 9,
            TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center,
            ZIndex = 15,
        })
        badge:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "AccentOff")
        badge:SetAttribute("TextSpanish", "APLICAR")
        badge:SetAttribute("TextEnglish", "APPLY")
        corner(badge, 999)
        mk("UIPadding", {Parent = badge, PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 8), PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 8)})

        local click = mk("TextButton", {
            Parent = holder,
            Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Text = "",
            AutoButtonColor = false,
            ZIndex = 16,
        })

        local selected = false
        local function setSelected(value)
            selected = value == true
            local backgroundTransparency = selected and 0.04 or 0.2
            local accentColor = selected and Theme.Accent or Theme.AccentOff
            local textColor = selected and Theme.AccentText or Theme.Text
            TweenService:Create(holder, TweenInfo.new(0.16, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
                BackgroundTransparency = backgroundTransparency,
            }):Play()
            TweenService:Create(glow, TweenInfo.new(0.16, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
                BackgroundColor3 = accentColor,
            }):Play()
            TweenService:Create(badge, TweenInfo.new(0.16, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
                BackgroundColor3 = accentColor,
                TextColor3 = textColor,
            }):Play()
            holderStroke.Transparency = selected and 0.05 or 0.48
            holderStroke.Thickness = selected and 2 or 1.2
            holderStroke:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", selected and "Accent" or "Stroke")
            holderStroke.Color = selected and Theme.Accent or Theme.Stroke
            holder:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "Secondary")
            glow:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", selected and "Accent" or "AccentOff")
            badge:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", selected and "Accent" or "AccentOff")
            badge:SetAttribute("TextSpanish", selected and "✓ ACTIVO" or "APLICAR")
            badge:SetAttribute("TextEnglish", selected and "✓ ACTIVE" or "APPLY")
            badge.Text = GetText(selected and "✓ ACTIVO" or "APLICAR", selected and "✓ ACTIVE" or "APPLY")
        end

        click.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
            TweenService:Create(holderScale, TweenInfo.new(0.14, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {Scale = 1.025}):Play()
            if not selected then
                TweenService:Create(holderStroke, TweenInfo.new(0.12), {Transparency = 0.25}):Play()
            end
        end)
        click.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
            TweenService:Create(holderScale, TweenInfo.new(0.18, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {Scale = 1}):Play()
            if not selected then
                TweenService:Create(holderStroke, TweenInfo.new(0.18), {Transparency = 0.48}):Play()
            end
        end)
        click.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            playSound(Sounds.Click, 0.55)
            holderScale.Scale = 0.96
            TweenService:Create(holderScale, TweenInfo.new(0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {Scale = 1}):Play()
            if spec.callback then spec.callback() end
        end)

        ShaderModeCards[spec.key] = {
            labelES = spec.labelES,
            labelEN = spec.labelEN,
            setSelected = setSelected,
        }
        setSelected(false)
        return holder
    end

    local function shaderCreateSection(parent, titleES, titleEN, descriptionES, descriptionEN)
        local SECTION_ICONS = {
            Lighting = 100212473103391, Atmosphere = 119344776018521, Clouds = 112291901900440, ColorCorrection = 118538685614420,
            ["Bloom y Blur"] = 81463911885004, DepthOfField = 93221074040832, SunRays = 82603845614781, ["Overdrive local"] = 98854559186277, Acciones = 100875301344852,
        }
        local section = mk("Frame", {
            Parent = parent,
            Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 0),
            AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
            BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Secondary,
            BackgroundTransparency = 0.24,
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
            ClipsDescendants = true,
            LayoutOrder = #ShaderUISections + 1,
            ZIndex = 312,
        })
        section:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "Secondary")
        corner(section, 14)
        stroke(section, Theme.Stroke, 1.2, 0.55)

        mk("UIPadding", {
            Parent = section,
            PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 10),
            PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 10),
            PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 10),
            PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 10),
        })
        mk("UIListLayout", {
            Parent = section,
            Padding = UDim.new(0, 8),
            SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
        })

        local head = mk("TextButton", {
            Parent = section,
            Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 34),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Text = "",
            AutoButtonColor = false,
            LayoutOrder = 0,
            ZIndex = 313,
        })
        local icon = mk("Frame", {
            Parent = head,
            Size = UDim2.fromOffset(34, 34),
            BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Accent,
            BackgroundTransparency = 0.82,
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
            ZIndex = 314,
        })
        icon:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "Accent")
        corner(icon, 10)
        RowKit.Icon(icon, SECTION_ICONS[titleES] or "◆", 18, 315, "Accent")
        local title = mk("TextLabel", {
            Parent = head,
            Size = UDim2.new(1, -110, 0, 18),
            Position = UDim2.new(0, 44, 0, 0),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Text = GetText(titleES, titleEN),
            TextColor3 = Theme.Accent,
            Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack,
            TextSize = 14,
            TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
            TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
            ZIndex = 314,
        })
        title:SetAttribute("ThemeTextRole", "Accent")
        title:SetAttribute("TextSpanish", titleES)
        title:SetAttribute("TextEnglish", titleEN)
        local count = mk("TextLabel", {
            Parent = head,
            Size = UDim2.new(1, -110, 0, 14),
            Position = UDim2.new(0, 44, 0, 19),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Text = "",
            TextColor3 = Theme.TextDim,
            Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium,
            TextSize = 10,
            TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
            ZIndex = 314,
        })
        count:SetAttribute("ThemeTextRole", "TextDim")
        local chevron = mk("TextLabel", {
            Parent = head,
            Size = UDim2.fromOffset(30, 30),
            AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5),
            Position = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.5, 0),
            BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Background,
            BackgroundTransparency = 0.3,
            Text = "▾",
            TextColor3 = Theme.Text,
            Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack,
            TextSize = 14,
            ZIndex = 314,
        })
        chevron:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "Background")
        chevron:SetAttribute("ThemeTextRole", "Text")
        corner(chevron, 999)

        local body = mk("Frame", {
            Parent = section,
            Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0),
            AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            LayoutOrder = 2,
            ZIndex = 312,
        })
        mk("UIListLayout", {
            Parent = body,
            Padding = UDim.new(0, 8),
            SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
        })

        if descriptionES and descriptionEN then
            local description = mk("TextLabel", {
                Parent = body,
                Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0),
                AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
                BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                Text = GetText(descriptionES, descriptionEN),
                TextColor3 = Theme.TextDim,
                Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium,
                TextSize = 10,
                TextWrapped = true,
                TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
                LayoutOrder = 0,
                ZIndex = 313,
            })
            description:SetAttribute("ThemeTextRole", "TextDim")
            description:SetAttribute("TextSpanish", descriptionES)
            description:SetAttribute("TextEnglish", descriptionEN)
        end

        local entry = {es = titleES, en = titleEN, frame = section, body = body, icon = SECTION_ICONS[titleES] or "◆"}
        entry.setOpen = function(open)
            entry.open = open == true
            body.Visible = entry.open
            chevron.Rotation = entry.open and 0 or -90
        end
        entry.updateCount = function()
            local n = 0
            for _, child in ipairs(body:GetChildren()) do
                if child:IsA("Frame") or child:IsA("TextButton") then n = n + 1 end
            end
            count.Text = GetText(n .. " ajustes", n .. " settings")
        end
        head.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            playSound(Sounds.Click, 0.4)
            entry.setOpen(not entry.open)
        end)
        entry.setOpen(#ShaderUISections == 0 or titleES == "Acciones")
        table.insert(ShaderUISections, entry)

        return body
    end

    local function shaderCreateToggle(parent, spec)
        local state = shaderReadCustomValue(spec, spec.default, "boolean")
        local holder = mk("Frame", {
            Parent = parent,
            Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 66),
            BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Background,
            BackgroundTransparency = 0.12,
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
            ZIndex = 313,
        })
        holder:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "Background")
        corner(holder, 12)
        stroke(holder, Theme.Stroke, 1.1, 0.62)

        local accent = mk("Frame", {
            Parent = holder,
            Size = UDim2.new(0, 3, 0, 30),
            Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0.5, -15),
            BackgroundColor3 = state and Theme.ToggleOn or Theme.AccentOff,
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
            ZIndex = 314,
        })
        accent:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", state and "ToggleOn" or "AccentOff")
        corner(accent, 99)

        local label = mk("TextLabel", {
            Parent = holder,
            Size = UDim2.new(1, -100, 0, 20),
            Position = UDim2.new(0, 22, 0, 8),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Text = GetText(spec.es, spec.en),
            TextColor3 = Theme.Text,
            Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
            TextSize = 12,
            TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
            ZIndex = 314,
        })
        label:SetAttribute("ThemeTextRole", "Text")
        label:SetAttribute("TextSpanish", spec.es)
        label:SetAttribute("TextEnglish", spec.en)

        local status = mk("TextLabel", {
            Parent = holder,
            Size = UDim2.new(1, -100, 0, 14),
            Position = UDim2.new(0, 22, 0, 29),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Text = state and GetText("Activado", "Enabled") or GetText("Desactivado", "Disabled"),
            TextColor3 = state and Theme.ToggleOn or Theme.TextDim,
            Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium,
            TextSize = 9,
            TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
            ZIndex = 314,
        })
        status:SetAttribute("ThemeTextRole", state and "ToggleOn" or "TextDim")

        local switch = mk("Frame", {
            Parent = holder,
            Size = UDim2.new(0, 48, 0, 25),
            Position = UDim2.new(1, -62, 0.5, -12),
            BackgroundColor3 = state and Theme.ToggleOn or Theme.AccentOff,
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
            ZIndex = 314,
        })
        switch:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", state and "ToggleOn" or "AccentOff")
        corner(switch, 99)

        local knob = mk("Frame", {
            Parent = switch,
            Size = UDim2.new(0, 21, 0, 21),
            Position = state and UDim2.new(1, -23, 0.5, -10) or UDim2.new(0, 2, 0.5, -10),
            BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
            ZIndex = 315,
        })
        corner(knob, 99)

        local click = mk("TextButton", {
            Parent = holder,
            Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Text = "",
            AutoButtonColor = false,
            ZIndex = 316,
        })

        local function applyVisual(animate)
            local tweenInfo = TweenInfo.new(animate and 0.18 or 0, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
            local color = state and Theme.ToggleOn or Theme.AccentOff
            local position = state and UDim2.new(1, -23, 0.5, -10) or UDim2.new(0, 2, 0.5, -10)
            TweenService:Create(switch, tweenInfo, {BackgroundColor3 = color}):Play()
            TweenService:Create(accent, tweenInfo, {BackgroundColor3 = color}):Play()
            TweenService:Create(knob, tweenInfo, {Position = position}):Play()
            switch:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", state and "ToggleOn" or "AccentOff")
            accent:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", state and "ToggleOn" or "AccentOff")
            status.Text = state and GetText("Activado", "Enabled") or GetText("Desactivado", "Disabled")
            status.TextColor3 = state and Theme.ToggleOn or Theme.TextDim
            status:SetAttribute("ThemeTextRole", state and "ToggleOn" or "TextDim")
        end

        local function setValue(newValue, invoke)
            state = newValue == true
            applyVisual(true)
            if invoke then
                ShaderCustomOverrides[spec.id] = state
                if type(spec.onChange) == "function" then
                    pcall(spec.onChange, state)
                else
                    shaderApplySingle(spec.target, spec.property, state)
                end
                shaderQueuePersistence()
            end
        end

        click.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            playSound(Sounds.Click, 0.45)
            setValue(not state, true)
        end)

        ShaderCustomControls[spec.id] = {
            refresh = function()
                local refreshed = shaderReadCustomValue(spec, state, "boolean")
                state = refreshed
                applyVisual(false)
            end,
            set = function(value)
                setValue(value, false)
            end,
        }
    end

    local function shaderCreateSlider(parent, spec)
        local value = shaderReadCustomValue(spec, spec.default, "number")
        local holder = mk("Frame", {
            Parent = parent,
            Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 78),
            BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Background,
            BackgroundTransparency = 0.12,
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
            ZIndex = 313,
        })
        holder:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "Background")
        holder:SetAttribute("IsShaderCustomSlider", true)
        corner(holder, 12)
        stroke(holder, Theme.Stroke, 1.1, 0.62)

        local label = mk("TextLabel", {
            Parent = holder,
            Size = UDim2.new(1, -140, 0, 18),
            Position = UDim2.new(0, 14, 0, 10),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Text = GetText(spec.es, spec.en),
            TextColor3 = Theme.Text,
            Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
            TextSize = 12,
            TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
            TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
            ZIndex = 314,
        })
        label:SetAttribute("ThemeTextRole", "Text")
        label:SetAttribute("TextSpanish", spec.es)
        label:SetAttribute("TextEnglish", spec.en)

        local valueLabel = mk("TextLabel", {
            Parent = holder,
            Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 22),
            AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X,
            AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0),
            Position = UDim2.new(1, -46, 0, 8),
            BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Accent,
            BackgroundTransparency = 0.82,
            Text = shaderFormatValue(value),
            TextColor3 = Theme.Accent,
            Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack,
            TextSize = 11,
            TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center,
            ZIndex = 315,
        })
        valueLabel:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "Accent")
        valueLabel:SetAttribute("ThemeTextRole", "Accent")
        valueLabel:SetAttribute("IgnoreTextEffect", true)
        corner(valueLabel, 999)
        mk("UIPadding", {Parent = valueLabel, PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 10), PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 10)})

        local resetButton = mk("TextButton", {
            Parent = holder,
            Size = UDim2.fromOffset(26, 22),
            AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0),
            Position = UDim2.new(1, -12, 0, 8),
            BackgroundColor3 = Theme.AccentOff,
            BackgroundTransparency = 0.2,
            Text = "",
            AutoButtonColor = false,
            ZIndex = 315,
        })
        resetButton:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "AccentOff")
        corner(resetButton, 999)
        RowKit.Icon(resetButton, 125802172782007, 13, 316, "Text")

        local bar = mk("Frame", {
            Parent = holder,
            Size = UDim2.new(1, -36, 0, 8),
            Position = UDim2.new(0, 18, 0, 44),
            BackgroundColor3 = Theme.AccentOff,
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
            ZIndex = 314,
        })
        bar:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "AccentOff")
        corner(bar, 99)

        local fill = mk("Frame", {
            Parent = bar,
            Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0),
            BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Accent,
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
            ZIndex = 315,
        })
        fill:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "Accent")
        corner(fill, 99)
        mk("UIGradient", {
            Parent = fill,
            Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(190, 190, 190), Color3.new(1, 1, 1)),
        })

        local defaultPercent = (spec.max - spec.min) == 0 and 0 or math.clamp((spec.default - spec.min) / (spec.max - spec.min), 0, 1)
        local defaultTick = mk("Frame", {
            Parent = bar,
            Size = UDim2.fromOffset(2, 14),
            AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
            Position = UDim2.new(defaultPercent, 0, 0.5, 0),
            BackgroundColor3 = Theme.TextDim,
            BackgroundTransparency = 0.3,
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
            ZIndex = 315,
        })
        defaultTick:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "TextDim")

        local thumb = mk("Frame", {
            Parent = bar,
            Size = UDim2.fromOffset(18, 18),
            AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
            Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.5, 0),
            BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
            ZIndex = 316,
        })
        corner(thumb, 99)
        local thumbRing = stroke(thumb, Theme.Accent, 3, 0)
        thumbRing:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "Accent")

        local minLabel = mk("TextLabel", {
            Parent = holder,
            Size = UDim2.new(0, 60, 0, 12),
            Position = UDim2.new(0, 14, 1, -18),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Text = shaderFormatValue(spec.min),
            TextColor3 = Theme.TextDim,
            Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium,
            TextSize = 9,
            TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
            ZIndex = 314,
        })
        minLabel:SetAttribute("ThemeTextRole", "TextDim")

        local maxLabel = mk("TextLabel", {
            Parent = holder,
            Size = UDim2.new(0, 60, 0, 12),
            Position = UDim2.new(1, -74, 1, -18),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Text = shaderFormatValue(spec.max),
            TextColor3 = Theme.TextDim,
            Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium,
            TextSize = 9,
            TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right,
            ZIndex = 314,
        })
        maxLabel:SetAttribute("ThemeTextRole", "TextDim")

        local dragging = false

        local function setValue(newValue, invoke)
            local range = spec.max - spec.min
            if spec.step and spec.step > 0 then
                newValue = math.floor((newValue / spec.step) + 0.5) * spec.step
            end
            value = math.clamp(newValue, spec.min, spec.max)
            local percent = range == 0 and 0 or math.clamp((value - spec.min) / range, 0, 1)
            fill.Size = UDim2.new(percent, 0, 1, 0)
            thumb.Position = UDim2.new(percent, 0, 0.5, 0)
            valueLabel.Text = shaderFormatValue(value)
            if invoke then
                ShaderCustomOverrides[spec.id] = value
                if type(spec.onChange) == "function" then
                    pcall(spec.onChange, value)
                else
                    shaderApplySingle(spec.target, spec.property, value)
                end
                shaderQueuePersistence()
            end
        end

        local function setFromInput(input)
            local width = math.max(1, bar.AbsoluteSize.X)
            local percent = math.clamp((input.Position.X - bar.AbsolutePosition.X) / width, 0, 1)
            setValue(spec.min + (spec.max - spec.min) * percent, true)
        end

        local function beginDrag(input)
            if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                if ShaderCustomActiveSlider and ShaderCustomActiveSlider ~= spec.id then return end
                ShaderCustomActiveSlider = spec.id
                dragging = true
                thumb.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(22, 22)
                setFromInput(input)
            end
        end

        shaderAddConnection(bar.InputBegan:Connect(beginDrag))
        shaderAddConnection(thumb.InputBegan:Connect(beginDrag))
        shaderAddConnection(UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
            if dragging and ShaderCustomActiveSlider == spec.id and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
                setFromInput(input)
            end
        end))
        shaderAddConnection(UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
            if ShaderCustomActiveSlider == spec.id and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
                dragging = false
                ShaderCustomActiveSlider = nil
                thumb.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(18, 18)
            end
        end))
        resetButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            playSound(Sounds.Click, 0.4)
            setValue(spec.default, true)
        end)

        setValue(value, false)

        ShaderCustomControls[spec.id] = {
            refresh = function()
                local refreshed = shaderReadCustomValue(spec, value, "number")
                setValue(refreshed, false)
            end,
            set = function(newValue)
                setValue(newValue, false)
            end,
        }
    end
